post.description:
Upload a file for Content Intelligence Hub extraction.

**How to test in Swagger**

1. Click **Authorize** and paste a Bearer token from `POST /api/v1/auth/token`.
2. Get a repository id from `GET /api/v1/repositories/options`.
3. Choose a file (see supported types below).
4. Set **repository_id**.
5. Leave **submit_for_processing** as `true`.
6. Execute. Copy `document_id` from the response.
7. Call **Get processing status** until the job is `COMPLETED`.
8. Then call **Get extracted content**, **Get chunks**, and **Get metadata**.
9. For audio or video, also call **Get transcript**.
10. For images, call **Summarize image (upload)** or **Summarize uploaded image**
    (uses Ollama `OPEN_WEIGHT_VLM_MODEL`, e.g. gemma3:27b).

**Supported files:** PDF (.pdf), Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx, .ppt), images (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .tif, .tiff, .bmp, .webp), audio (.wav, .mp3, .m4a, .aac, .flac, .ogg), video (.mp4, .mov, .avi, .mkv, .webm)

Transcription uses updated CIH ASR settings (`ASR_MODEL_NAME` / `CIH_FASTER_WHISPER_MODEL`).
Image summary uses Ollama (`OPEN_WEIGHT_VLM_*` / `OLLAMA_*`).

strict_key_field_page_scope.title: Strict Key Field Page Scope
strict_key_field_page_scope.description: When true, key field extraction is limited to first 2 and last page only, and skips extraction if page metadata is missing.

validation_enabled.title: Validation Enabled
validation_enabled.description: When true, enqueue document_validation after key_field_extraction.

validation_confidence_threshold.title: Validation Confidence Threshold
validation_confidence_threshold.description: Confidence threshold for PASS vs WARNING (default 0.85).

citation_retainment.title: Citation Retainment
citation_retainment.description: Preserve citation/source spans in chunked output.

template_extraction.title: Template Extraction
template_extraction.description: When true, enqueue template_extraction processor jobs.

reference_document_extraction.title: Reference Document Extraction
reference_document_extraction.description: When true, enqueue reference_document_extraction processor jobs.

conversion_for_rendering.title: Conversion For Rendering
conversion_for_rendering.description: When true, enqueue conversion_for_rendering processor jobs.

intelligent_extraction.title: Intelligent Extraction
intelligent_extraction.description: When true, enqueue content intelligence (intelligence_extraction) processor jobs.

content_intelligence.title: Content Intelligence
content_intelligence.description: Alias for intelligent_extraction — enables content intelligence extraction.

document_type_id.title: Document Type Id
document_type_id.description: Default document type UUID for documents in this repository.

extraction_model.title: Extraction Model
extraction_model.description: Model hint passed to metadata extraction processors.

reranking.title: Reranking
reranking.description: Optional per-repository rerank default. None inherits platform RERANKER_ENABLED; true opts in; false opts out.

retrieval_search_mode.title: Retrieval Search Mode
retrieval_search_mode.description: Default retrieval mode for this repository.

lexical_composition.title: Lexical Composition
lexical_composition.description: When true, hybrid/keyword search uses BM25; when false, vector-only modes apply.

RepositorySettings.title: RepositorySettings
RepositorySettings.description: Processing and retrieval settings stored per repository (MySQL repository_settings.settings).

document_id.title: Document Id
document_id.description: When set, restrict retrieval to chunks from this document (merged into filters).

folder_id.title: Folder Id
folder_id.description: Optional automatically created logical folder ID from GET /api/v1/repositories/{repository_id}/folders. When set, only chunks whose indexed logical_folder_id matches this folder participate in retrieval. Omit to search the entire repository. The folder must belong to repository_id.

folder_ids.title: Folder Ids
folder_ids.description: Optional list of automatically created logical folder IDs from GET /api/v1/repositories/{repository_id}/folders. Combined with folder_id when both are set (union / OR). Each ID must belong to repository_id. Omit, together with folder_id, to search the entire repository.

repository_id.title: Repository Id
repository_id.description: Repository that scopes retrieval. Required when folder_id or folder_ids is set.

repository_ids.title: Repository Ids
repository_ids.description: Search across multiple repositories. Overrides repository_id when set.

search_all_repositories.title: Search All Repositories
search_all_repositories.description: When true and no repository_id/repository_ids, search all active repositories.

model_name.title: Model Name
model_name.description: Optional query embedding model override (Hub id or local path).

model_dir.title: Model Dir
model_dir.description: Optional local model directory under src/models for query embeddings.

hybrid_alpha.title: Hybrid Alpha
hybrid_alpha.description: Override alpha for hybrid retrieval fusion. 0=BM25 only, 1=vector only, 0.75=default.

expand_query.title: Expand Query
expand_query.description: When false, query expansion is skipped and expanded_queries is empty. When true, a configured rewrite provider may return additional queries. If no rewrite provider/model is available, the original query is used and expanded_queries remains empty (documented fallback; no synthetic expansions).

use_production_pipeline.title: Use Production Pipeline
use_production_pipeline.description: When true, run Prompt Guard→RRF→Top-K rerank pipeline. Defaults to platform config.

debug_retrieval.title: Debug Retrieval
debug_retrieval.description: When true, include full retrieval metrics, pipeline trace, and candidate statistics.

bbox.title: Bbox
bbox.description: PDF points: x0, top, x1, bottom

password.title: Password
password.description: Platform user password. For the bootstrap admin, use PLATFORM_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD from deploy/application/.env (not a Swagger placeholder).

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Key-field values to override by field name.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional reason recorded in key-field audit events.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: User-defined metadata key/value pairs to store on the document.

merge.title: Merge
merge.description: When true (default), merge into existing metadata. When false, replace user metadata but preserve system keys.

change_reason.title: Change Reason
change_reason.description: Optional operator comment recorded in the audit trail.

owner_user_name.title: Owner User Name
owner_user_name.description: Display name for the repository owner.

default_tenant_id.title: Default Tenant Id
default_tenant_id.description: Optional default Weaviate tenant id for this repository.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Optional nested settings patch (same semantics as PATCH .../settings).

UpdateRepositoryRequest.description:
